body:
**Description**
A simple hull shader with the patchconstantfunc attribute causes a crash when compiled with the -fspv-debug=vulkan-with-source flag. Without the flag it compiles fine.

Possibly related issues: #7033 #7232 

**Steps to Reproduce**
https://godbolt.org/z/Y89r6r8a6

**Actual Behavior**
SIGSEGV
Read access violation, `SpirvEmitter::doFunctionDecl` is calling `SpirvContext::pushDebugLexicalScope` with `info = nullptr`. It seems that for some reason it fails to create debug information for the patch constant function?

**Environment**
- DXC version: 1.9 - 1.8.0.4806 (75a029d95)
- Host Operating System: Windows 10

comments.body: I hope this will be fixed in the next release. Failing to compile any Hull shader with debug info seems like a major issue.
FYI: @SteveUrquhart Do you know anything about this? I might get to it at some point, but I don't know when.
@s-perron, I have not seen this before, but I'm not surprised, and you can assign it to me.  It appears to be a duplicate of https://github.com/microsoft/DirectXShaderCompiler/issues/7232.

Tested on the latest version and the provided shader compiles (godbolt link also compiles now).
Considering this resolved 🙂

title: [SPIR-V] SIGSEGV when compiling a hull shader with -fspv-debug=vulkan-with-source
